gloss: to consent; to accept; to acknowledge; to agree to

definitions.gloss: to consent; to accept; to acknowledge; to agree to

examples.japanese: ご{了承|りょうしょう}ください。
{上司|じょうし}の{了承|りょうしょう}を{得|え}てから{進|すす}めます。
examples.english: I will proceed after obtaining my supervisor's consent.

examples.japanese: {予定|よてい}が{変更|へんこう}になる{場合|ばあい}がございますので、あらかじめご{了承|りょうしょう}ください。
examples.english: The schedule may be subject to change, so please accept this in advance.

notes:
A formal term meaning to understand and accept a situation or request, especially one involving an inconvenience or condition. Very common in business and official contexts. The polite form ご{了承|りょうしょう}ください is one of the most frequently seen business phrases.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ご{了承|りょうしょう}ください: please understand/accept (polite request)
- {了承|りょうしょう}を{得|え}る: to obtain consent
- {了承|りょうしょう}を{求|もと}める: to seek consent
- あらかじめご{了承|りょうしょう}ください: please accept this in advance
- ご{了承|りょうしょう}いただく: to have someone consent (humble)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {承認|しょうにん}する: to approve — implies formal, official approval with authority
- {許可|きょか}する: to permit — granting explicit permission
- {了解|りょうかい}する: to understand/acknowledge — more casual acknowledgment; common in everyday work communication
- {承知|しょうち}する: to understand/accept — humble form used when accepting instructions from a superior
